dedupe_keys.name: agenthomeid agent based model of home owners investment decisions

description: AgentHomeID - Agent-based model of Home owners' investment decisions is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Fraunhofer IEE, Universität Kassel. Regional or German-wide modelling of building stock development under the decisions of the buildings' owners. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: Agent-based modelling, Behavioural economics, Building stock modelling. Spatial resolution: national states, households. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
